name: pitboard
description: A status row for Claude Code, drawn through function hooks in the CLI and in Claude Code Desktop on Windows, macOS and Linux: context against the auto-compaction point, the prompt cache's time to live and hit rate, the five-hour and weekly limits with their pace, and on a click or hover the model, effort, advisor, branch, session time and API cost. /pitboard opens every reading in a pane. Reads paceline's limits file when it exists, to show readings other sessions saw; writes no file. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287 or later.
